items.html: However, since the body of man is divided into two parts, as is known — for until the chest the foundation of Bina spreads, and the lights within it are covered, while from the chest downward the lights are revealed, as explained by us in the secret of the Hassadim that spread within the Tifferet of ZA — therefore his body was divided into two worlds: his upper half, which is covered, was placed in the six last [Sefirot] of Yetzira, and his lower half, which is revealed, was placed in the first four of Assiya.
